scope: Local caller contracts and full native positive qualifications

automatic production plans keep their declared SIFT job and never silently activate SSG
automatic SIFT provider rejects an injected SSG algorithm before native computation or evidence preparation
all production automatic SIFT plans still reach their original shared sparse engine and resource hooks
native panel fallback, ordered identity, disabled zones and four real submissions
complete analysis adds only ELA; M3/M4 receive independent native settings
selection and plan own coordinates; empty manual selection never becomes whole-image
automatic sparse adapter forwards lazy source storage and leaves borrowed session ownership with the source
automatic SIFT consumes bounded source rows and windows without retaining full RGB
public integration facade preserves explicit missing engines and caller-owned source
all-disabled complete selection allocates no ELA provider or fallback analysis
automatic Panels+Text empty-panel result completes without requiring OCR weights
sparse NPZ checks the metadata bound before building a large nested mirror
M3 model replacement awaits the real disposer, holds old resources and keeps the public engine busy
unloading M3 models waits for workers while preserving the image and accounting
unloading a source preserves its bytes and retained ownership until its M3 disposer finishes
engine disposal holds all ownership until M3 closure and only then clears the common budget
a failed M3 source closure preserves the original cause, image and accounting for a useful retry
model replacement failures keep the authoritative old resources and release the unused destination
all image closures settle before model release and a successful closure is not repeated after a peer failure
concurrent adapter close requests coalesce the same real disposer rather than double-closing the worker
SSG result provenance names the real author pipeline and explicitly identifies its paper-v2 protocol
actual EfficientLoFTR archive labels confidence, while classical archives retain descriptor distance
full SSG archive keeps the original-grid localization mask separately from biome hulls
SSG presents its exact mask with the compiled renderer and keeps the original unchanged
general clone tool loads the same pinned SSG resource catalog once and preserves its native task
All generated numeric defaults pass native bounds and stepping rules, including automatic empty fields
Decimal parameters accept scientific values between UI increments without weakening bounds
Decimal keyboard editing retains schema increments, stable decimals and endpoint bounds
Integer and parity constraints survive restored invalid values; Calculate blockers report the field
Full SSG controls deliver only native parameters and keep prior detector IDs stable
SIFT G2NN algorithm defaults retain their fractional scientific distance after switching detectors
SSG batch exposes only its scientific native parameters and passes their exact defaults
SSG edited parameters and explicit batch panels retain their scientific values and original coordinates
temporarily removing every clone uses total and restores the user’s clone preference on reactivation
an explicitly selected total basis survives clone removal, reactivation and saved-setting reload
a saved automatic total fallback retains the preferred clone basis when SSG is selected later
SSG batch evidence uses exact localized pixels, preserves holes and does not invent biome hull coverage

dense search propagates scientific exclusions instead of clearing them, without sending unsupported M3 scope fields
SSG, two-real-ROI EfficientLoFTR and Forgeryscope retain their distinct scientific contracts
segmentation and D2PRL receive true acquisition ROIs only and never unknown algorithm parameters
incomplete preparation cannot become a full-frame task
cross-study scope keeps two original image envelopes for searching while all text, graph gaps and padding remain excluded

qualificationLimits: The 46 cases are caller, ownership, UI, rendering, archive and native-empty tests; they are not 46 positive detector runs.
ssg-entrypoints.test.mjs exercises actual native VLFeat and localization on a uniform 48 x 48 source with normalizationLongEdge=0. No matched words means no structured-forest download.
The general tool-client resource test uses a protocol engine stub; lifecycle tests use controlled detector/disposal stubs. Neither is claimed as positive native inference.
Localized-mask rendering and archive fixtures validate preservation of scientific outputs rather than executing the complete detector.
